name: ⚠️ Acid Escape
desc:
Play for 10 minutes to get a Lucky Block for FREE!

🎮 Welcome to Escape The Acid, this is a Lava Survival game where you have to survive the platformer obby's and escape the rising lava in countless maps, and gather points to unlock cool gears and other things that can help you survive and escape the lava. 

Tags: The Floor Is LAVA, Lava, Obby, Lava Survival
